defs.def: before now or before a particular time in the past 已经；早已

ex.s: On their first trip out, they were greeted with such enthusiasm from the 10 families who’d already established homes there that they decided to join.
ex.t: 第一次实地探访时，已在那里安家的10户人家热情相迎，这让他们决定加入。

ex.s: I breathed a huge sigh of relief: I had expected sadness, maybe even doubt, but Dad was already looking to the future.
ex.t: 我长长地松了一口气：我本以为会是伤感，甚至可能是疑虑，但爸爸已经在展望未来。

ex.s: Snow — already threatened by a warming climate — absorbs different chemicals from the atmosphere as temperatures rise, which changes its cold-clean scent.
ex.t: 雪——已受到气候变暖的威胁——随着气温升高会从大气中吸收不同的化学物质，从而改变它清冷洁净的气味。

ex.s: Helping strangers can leave you with a deep sense of satisfaction, but you’ve likely also felt the stress of showing up for others when you’re already stretched thin.
ex.t: 帮助陌生人会给你一种深深的满足感，但你也可能体会过在自己已经分身乏术时还要为他人付出的压力。

ex.s: From technological solutions to educational campaigns, food producers and sellers are looking for ways to use more of what we’re already growing.
ex.t: 从技术解决方案到教育活动，食品生产者和销售者正在寻找方法来更多地利用我们已经种植的东西。

ex.s: As the speaker, you already know what you’re going to say.
ex.t: 作为演讲者，你已经知道自己会说什么。

ex.s: She says that Western culture already pushes people to look for the silver lining behind every cloud.
ex.t: 她说西方文化已经促使人们在每一朵乌云背后寻找一线希望。

ex.s: As we soon come to learn from AI by Design AI is already super-smart and will become more capable, moving from the current generation of “narrow-AI” to Artificial General Intelligence.
ex.t: 正如我们很快就能从《设计人工智能》中了解到的那样，人工智能已经超级聪明，并且将变得更强大，从当前的“狭义人工智能”发展到通用人工智能。

ex.s: Research sometimes proves, with data, what we more or less already know（e. g.
ex.t: 研究有时会用数据证明我们多少已经知道的事（例如……）。

ex.s: *Log in to Handshake using your email address already provided by the college.
ex.t: 使用学院已提供的邮箱地址登录Handshake。

ex.s: Long before reading and writing became widely spread and available, oral storytelling had already been a form that the wisdom and knowledge of the people were passed down from elders to children.
ex.t: 早在读写广泛普及之前，口头讲故事就已是人们将智慧和知识从长辈传给孩子的一种形式。

ex.s: "The sweet spot in life to start exercising, if you haven't already, is in late middle age when the heart still has flexibility," Levine says.
ex.t: "如果你还没有开始运动，生命中开始运动的最佳时期是中年晚期，这时心脏仍有弹性，"Levine说。

ex.s: Drones are already being used to examine high-tension electrical lines.
ex.t: 它们可以做完全相同的事情来检查铁路线路和其他重要的铁路基础设施，如铁轨的正确位置和道岔。

ex.s: Much still needed to be done before dinner was served, but already outside the building many homeless people were gathering.
ex.t: 晚餐供应之前还有很多事情要做，但建筑物外面已经聚集了许多无家可归的人。

ex.s: She's healthy, strong and already eager to play and explore.
ex.t: 她身体健康，强壮，已经渴望玩耍和探索。

ex.s: Already, a number of films, including "Water for Elephants," "The Hangover Part Ⅱ" and "Zookeeper," have drawn the anger of activists who say the creatures acting in them haven’t been treated properly.
ex.t: 已经有不少影片，包括《大象的眼泪》《宿醉2》和《动物园看守》，引来了活动人士的愤怒，他们说片中动物的待遇不当。

ex.s: Lancom is the only product to offer courses tailored to your native language, building on grammar and words you already know.
ex.t: Lancom是唯一提供根据母语量身定制课程的产品，在你已掌握的语法和词汇基础上进行构建。

ex.s: In some respects, today's powerful computing machines already make our brains look weak.
ex.t: 在某些方面，如今强大的计算机器已经让我们的大脑显得弱小。

ex.s: It also doesn't require a new type of technology that people aren't already familiar with.
ex.t: 它也不需要人们尚不熟悉的新技术。

ex.s: If you are already making the time to exercise, it is good indeed!
ex.t: 如果你已经在腾出时间锻炼，那真是太好了！

ex.s: It had already been placed in a carrier for safety.
ex.t: 为了安全起见，它已经被放进了一个笼子里。

ex.s: Around 100 people have already put down a $10,000 deposit to get a Transition when they go on sale, and those numbers will likely rise after Terrafugia introduces the Transition to the public later this week at the New York Auto Show.
ex.t: 已有约100人支付了1万美元定金，准备在Transition上市时入手，而且随着Terrafugia本周晚些时候在纽约车展上向公众推出Transition，这一数字很可能还会上升。

ex.s: The govemment has already permitted the company to use special materials to make it easier for the vehicle to fly.
ex.t: 政府已经允许该公司使用特殊材料，使这款车辆更容易飞行。

ex.s: Around 100 people have already put down a $10,000 deposit to get a Transition when they go on sale, and those numbers will likely rise after Terrafugia introduces the Transition to the public later this week at the New York Auto Show.
ex.t: 已有约100人支付了1万美元定金，准备在Transition上市时入手，而且随着Terrafugia本周晚些时候在纽约车展上向公众推出Transition，这一数字很可能还会上升。

ex.s: In Peru, local farmers around a mountain with a glacier that has already fallen victim to climate change have begun painting the entire mountain peak white in the hope that the added reflectiveness will restore the life-giving ice.
ex.t: 在秘鲁，一座山峰的冰川已成为气候变化的牺牲品，周围的当地农民开始把整个山顶漆成白色，希望增加的反射率能恢复那赋予生命的冰。

ex.s: Already this year, 115 measles cases have been reported in the USA, compared with 189 for all of last year.
ex.t: 今年到目前为止，美国已报告115例麻疹病例，而去年全年为189例。

ex.s: Before reading a passage, think of what you already know about the topic.
ex.t: 在阅读一篇文章之前，想想你对这个主题已经知道的事情。

ex.s: New York City is located in the north-east of the US and was already a big city by then.
ex.t: 纽约市位于美国东北部，当时已经是一个大城市。

ex.s: It has already affected many things in our lives, right down to the food we eat.
ex.t: 它已经影响了我们生活中的许多事情，包括我们吃的食物。

ex.s: For example, you may already know some facts about the Chinese horse painter, Han Gan and his paintings.
ex.t: 例如，你可能已经知道了一些关于中国马画家韩干和他的画的事实。

ex.s: Yet, despite all this, by the end of the trip many were already planning to return.
ex.t: 然而，尽管如此，到旅行结束时，许多人已经计划返回。

ex.s: Because they have already bought new shoes.
ex.t: 因为他们已经买了新鞋子。

ex.s: The government has already permitted the company to use special materials to make it easier for the vehicle to fly.
ex.t: 36     ，有几种方法可以应对这种情况。让我们现在来看看这些方法。
